what: A Eurorack-style modular synth: 56 modules (VCOs, a Moog-style ladder, a Moog 960-style sequencer that plays your voices, a low pass gate, Turing, Marbles, chaos, effects) patched with cables on the FM-1 itself, a 64-step sequencer with live recording, 33 factory patches, visuals, USB audio and MIDI.
